landing.heroSubhead: Booking site, online shop, or marketing website — pick a vertical, combine themes, layouts, visual styles and color palettes, then publish on your own domain. Hosted, updated and scaled by us.
landing.verticalsBody: Same five-minute setup, same hosting, same custom domain. The site behind it is built for the kind of business you run — not a one-size-fits-all template.
landing.verticalApptBody: Salons, clinics, coaches, studios. Calendar, staff, services, working hours, customer portal. Online bookings 24/7 — even while you sleep.
landing.verticalEcomBody: Catalog, cart, checkout, delivery. Shopify-style admin without the complexity. Razorpay (IN) + Stripe Connect (global) built in — money never touches us.
landing.verticalStaticBody: When you just need a beautiful site. Hero, about, custom pages, contact form. No booking widgets, no shop. Live in five minutes flat.
landing.marqueeLabel: Built for every kind of small business — booking, shop or simple site
landing.shiftBody: You're great at what you do. You shouldn't be playing receptionist at 10pm. This is what changes when your bookings run on a real, hosted platform — on your domain, managed by us.
landing.beforeNoStorefrontRest: , or a form that looks like a 2012 blog
landing.afterBranded: A storefront that looks like your industry
landing.afterDomain: Your own domain, hosted by us
landing.howBody: Most people finish before their coffee gets cold. Your storefront goes live on your domain — fully hosted and managed by DriftHR — by the end of this section.
landing.step1Body: Start from 40+ industry-specific theme families, then combine layouts, visual styles and brand colors. A law firm looks like a law firm. A spa looks like a spa. Not a form on a white page.
landing.step2Body: Drop in your logo, write one headline, set your hours. Every change shows up live on the right. What you see is what ships.
landing.step3Body: Launch on an included DriftHR subdomain, or connect your own brand domain in a click. Drop the URL anywhere — Instagram, WhatsApp, Google. Bookings start flowing.
landing.themesBody: Start from an industry theme, switch layouts, tune visual style and apply brand colors. The result feels custom without a custom-build timeline. Previews below are real DriftHR theme directions.
landing.pricingBody: Choose a paid plan, use any included trial, and activate the tools your business needs. Cancel anytime.
landing.pricingLaunchBadge: Trials and limits are configured per plan. Third-party add-ons bill separately.
landing.testimonialsBody: Early customers who shipped their booking site in a single afternoon.
landing.faqBody: Straight answers. No "contact sales to learn more." If something's missing, email us and we'll add it here.
landing.finalCtaBody: Booking, shop or simple site — pick what you need, customize with themes, layouts and colors, then launch on your own domain. AI-powered assistance starts rolling into the builder next.
landing.footerTagline: AI-powered websites in minutes. Booking, shop or marketing site — hosted, branded and managed for every small business. Made in India.
landing.footerVersion: v1.0 · Themes, layouts, colors and AI assistance
